# Custom Bedrock Extension

Routes AI requests through a custom Bedrock-compatible AI gateway.

## Purpose
Enables Pi to use a custom gateway that speaks the AWS Bedrock
Converse protocol but authenticates via Bearer token instead of AWS SigV4.

## Configuration
- CUSTOM_BEDROCK_URL: Gateway base URL (env var)
- CUSTOM_BEDROCK_TOKEN: Bearer token (env var)

## Key Components
- Provider: Registers "custom-bedrock" provider with Pi
- Streaming: Full ConverseStream support (text, images, tools, thinking)
- Auth: Bearer token injection via AWS SDK middleware (SigV4 bypassed)

## Dependencies
- @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime: AWS Bedrock SDK
- @mariozechner/pi-ai: Pi AI types and utilities
- @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent: Pi extension API
